description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walahamulla, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420050
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
